sn35.165:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn35.165:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.165:1.3: kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
sn35.165:2.1: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.165:2.2: rūpe aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.165:2.3: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.165:2.4: cakkhusamphassaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyati …pe…
sn35.165:2.5: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.165:2.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
